limitations: Only complex two-dimensional affine-function systems on a proper single circle arc, with exactly two natural point evaluations; no arbitrary functional-sampling optimum, unrestricted Banach–Mazur distance, higher degree, or multi-arc statement. Earlier exact complex-arc degree-one Lebesgue formulas may be incompletely indexed.
scientific_integrity: Full analytic proof provided for arbitrary arc apertures and all admissible node pairs; finite checker is corroborative, not an infinite proof. Literature priority is assessed from inspected sources and may require independent verification.
title: Unique optimal two-sample norming of complex circular-arc function planes
